description: Open the in-game Info / Tutorial popup and BROWSE THE WHOLE GUIDE: dwell on the top of the page, then wheel DOWN to the bottom one viewport at a time (90% steps, so no band of the document falls between two shots), pausing at each screenful, and rest at the end. The tutorial spans several screens, so a clip of only the first screen cannot support 'the content/images are all correct' — this exposes every screenful in one clip instead. The page is a CROSS-ORIGIN WebView: only a real mouse wheel can scroll it (the bridge is blocked by the browser) and its scroll position cannot be read back, so the step count is fixed and over-wheeling harmlessly clamps at the end. Marks TUTORIAL TOP / BOTTOM for the ACTION TIMELINE. Exposes facts.tutorial_open (the WebView was really there, not an empty popup), reached_bottom (the full planned scroll was issued — that the pixels MOVED is a video claim, not a bridge one) and scroll_steps. Set scroll_back=True to also page back UP (Mah_058 next/previous). Unreached if the info button never becomes clickable.

cases.title: The tutorial opens and its content can be read through

image.prompt:
These screenshots are Grandma Pets' in-game information guide, captured one screenful at a time as it was scrolled from top to bottom. Read them as ONE document, in order, and answer about the whole of it.
(1) guide_opens: do the screenshots show a real guide with content, rather than an empty frame or a loading screen? (2) pages_differ: does each screenshot show a different part of the guide, i.e. was it paged through rather than showing the same screen repeatedly? (3) text_readable: across every screenful, is the text laid out properly, without running off the edge, overlapping, or being cut in half? (4) images_load: are the pictures actually drawn (symbols, feature artwork) rather than blank boxes, broken-image icons or placeholders? (5) images_in_place: is each picture placed where it belongs next to the text it illustrates, not overlapping text, cut off, or out of place? (6) sections_seen: list the section headings you can read, in order, as a JSON array of strings. (7) ui_broken: on any screenful, is anything else overlapping, placeholder or visibly broken?

data.reason: The screenshots show a fully functional and populated in-game information guide. Each screenshot displays a different, continuous part of the guide as it's scrolled. All text is clearly laid out and readable, with no overlapping or cut-off parts. Images (symbols, feature artwork) are correctly loaded and placed adjacent to their descriptive text without any visible issues. No other UI elements appear broken or out of place; the header and close button are consistent, and a scrollbar is present, indicating the content's length.
